questions.question_en: A 22-year-old young man with a history of diabetes since 6 months ago, who presented with diabetic ketoacidosis and since then has been treated with 20 units of insulin glargine and 3 units of insulin aspart with each main meal, in the last 2 months, due to frequent drops in blood sugar, he stopped insulin aspart and only consumes 10 units of glargine daily. There is a family history of diabetes in the patient's grandfather. BS 2hpp=140 mg/dl, FBS=90 mg/dl, HbA1C=6.5%, BMI=21. What is the appropriate course of action?

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «کاهش دوز انسولین بر اساس نیاز بیمار همراه با پایش روزانه قند خون (Insulin Dose Reduction)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.explanation_en: Calcium interpretation is done with albumin or ionized calcium. In increasing calcium, PTH is the first differential branch; High PTH goes to hyperparathyroidism and low PTH goes to malignancy/vitamin D and other causes. Osteoporosis is diagnosed by fragility fracture or T-score and treated with adequate calcium/vitamin D, exercise, and antiresorptive or bone-forming drugs. CKD-MBD requires simultaneous interpretation of calcium, phosphorus, PTH and vitamin D.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «داروی مهارکننده آنزیم دی‌پپتیدیل پپتیداز چهار سیتاگلیپتین (Sitagliptin / DPP-4i)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «داروی مهارکننده آنزیم دی‌پپتیدیل پپتیداز چهار سیتاگلیپتین (Sitagliptin / DPP-4i)» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.
questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.question_en: A 65-year-old female patient has come to us complaining of fatigue and hair loss. She also mentions a history of PCI one year ago and high blood pressure. In the tests performed, she has Chol: 290, TG: 200, T4: 4.3, TSH: 22, Cr: 0.9; The patient also had TSH: 20 in tests 3 months ago. What is your most likely diagnosis and recommended course of action?

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.question_en: Which of the following statements about acarbose is not true?
options_fa: مصرف همزمان آکاربوز با داروی گلی‌بن‌کلامید موجب کاهش معنادار سطح سرمی و غلظت پلاسمایی گلی‌بن‌کلامید می‌شود.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

It should be mentioned that he has lost 10 kg in the last three months and he mentions a history of high blood pressure more than a year ago. Currently, the blood pressure is 150.95 mmHg. What are your treatment goals to control his disease as best as possible and which treatment do you prefer?

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «اندازه‌گیری غلظت سرمی فاکتور رشد شبه‌انسولین یک (Serum IGF-1)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

questions.explanation_en: Calcium interpretation is done with albumin or ionized calcium. In increasing calcium, PTH is the first differential branch; High PTH goes to hyperparathyroidism and low PTH goes to malignancy/vitamin D and other causes. Osteoporosis is diagnosed by fragility fracture or T-score and treated with adequate calcium/vitamin D, exercise, and antiresorptive or bone-forming drugs. CKD-MBD requires simultaneous interpretation of calcium, phosphorus, PTH and vitamin D.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «شروع درمان دارویی با مسدودکننده گیرنده آنژیوتانسین لوزارتان (Losartan / ARB)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. questions.explanation_en: Pituitary disease is investigated with target hormone and trophic hormone pattern, pressure symptoms and MRI. High prolactin should be separated from pregnancy, medication, hypothyroidism and stalk effect; Macroprolactinoma is usually treated with a dopamine agonist. questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «فشار خون شریانی سیستولی مساوی یا بالاتر از ۱۳۰ یا دیاستولی مساوی یا بالاتر از ۸۵ میلی‌متر جیوه (نظیر فشار خون 135/85 mmHg)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «فشار خون شریانی سیستولی مساوی یا بالاتر از ۱۳۰ یا دیاستولی مساوی یا بالاتر از ۸۵ میلی‌متر جیوه (نظیر فشار خون 135/85 mmHg)» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.
questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Pituitary disease is investigated with target hormone and trophic hormone pattern, pressure symptoms and MRI. High prolactin should be separated from pregnancy, medication, hypothyroidism and stalk effect; Macroprolactinoma is usually treated with a dopamine agonist. Acromegaly is confirmed by IGF-1 screening and post-sugar test/MRI. In multiaxial hypothyroidism, glucocorticoid is given before thyroid hormone.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Calcium interpretation is done with albumin or ionized calcium. In increasing calcium, PTH is the first differential branch; High PTH goes to hyperparathyroidism and low PTH goes to malignancy/vitamin D and other causes. Osteoporosis is diagnosed by fragility fracture or T-score and treated with adequate calcium/vitamin D, exercise, and antiresorptive or bone-forming drugs. CKD-MBD requires simultaneous interpretation of calcium, phosphorus, PTH and vitamin D.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.explanation_en: Calcium interpretation is done with albumin or ionized calcium. In increasing calcium, PTH is the first differential branch; High PTH goes to hyperparathyroidism and low PTH goes to malignancy/vitamin D and other causes. Osteoporosis is diagnosed by fragility fracture or T-score and treated with adequate calcium/vitamin D, exercise, and antiresorptive or bone-forming drugs. CKD-MBD requires simultaneous interpretation of calcium, phosphorus, PTH and vitamin D.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Primary adrenal insufficiency is suggested by hypotension, hyponatremia, increased potassium, and pallor of the skin and is confirmed by morning cortisol/ACTH and provocation test. Adrenal crisis requires immediate intravenous hydrocortisone and serum. Cushing's is diagnosed with cortisol excess and standard screening tests; Once proven, ACTH directs the cause. Pheochromocytoma is diagnosed with metanephrines and treated with alpha block before beta block.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.explanation_en: Calcium interpretation is done with albumin or ionized calcium. In increasing calcium, PTH is the first differential branch; High PTH goes to hyperparathyroidism and low PTH goes to malignancy/vitamin D and other causes. Osteoporosis is diagnosed by fragility fracture or T-score and treated with adequate calcium/vitamin D, exercise, and antiresorptive or bone-forming drugs. CKD-MBD requires simultaneous interpretation of calcium, phosphorus, PTH and vitamin D.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

High prolactin should be separated from pregnancy, medication, hypothyroidism and stalk effect; Macroprolactinoma is usually treated with a dopamine agonist. questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.question_en: A 20-year-old man with no history of diabetes mellitus was admitted with the diagnosis of diabetic ketoacidosis with the following tests: Blood sugar: 500 mg/dl PH: 7.10: 10 3: 24 mmHg HCO 2 PCO Chloride: 95 Na: 140 K: 5 Serum ketone: 1: 8 + ve (Nitroprusside reaction) Four hours after treatment, despite the decrease in blood sugar, serum ketone It has become positive and increased with a dilution of 1 to 16. What is the most likely cause?
options_fa: گزارش اشتباه و خطای آزمایشگاهی در کتون سرم بدو ورود بیمار
عدم تجویز داروی انسولین تزریقی به میزان کافی و پیشرفت بیماری

questions.explanation_fa:
تحلیل بالینی و صورت مسئله: در این سناریو، بیمار با تظاهرات «آقای ۲۰ ساله‌ای با کتواسیدوز دیابتی (DKA) در بدو ورود با آزمایشات: قند خون BS=500 mg/dL, pH=7.10, HCO3=10, PCO2=24 و تیتر کتون سرم با روش نیتروپروساید مثبت ۱:۸ بستری شده است؛ پس از ۴ ساعت انفوزیون نرمال سالین و انسولین، علیرغم کاهش قند خون به ۲۵۰ و بهبود بیمار، تیتر کتون سرم با روش نیتروپروساید به صورت متناقض به ۱:۱۶ افزایش نشان می‌دهد! محتمل‌ترین علت علمی چیست؟» در حیطه تخصصی غدد تحت ارزیابی قرار گرفته است. با استناد به مبانی تشخیصی و تصمیم‌گیری بالینی مرجع کانونی اصول طب داخلی هاریسون (ویرایش ۲۲)، بخش غدد درون‌ریز، متابولیسم و دیابت، اقدام انتخابی و پاسخ صحیح بالینی «اکسیداسیون و تبدیل هورمونی بتا-هیدروکسی‌بوتیرات به استواستات در طی روند بهبودی با انسولین (Conversion of Beta-Hydroxybutyrate to Acetoacetate)» می‌باشد.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «اکسیداسیون و تبدیل هورمونی بتا-هیدروکسی‌بوتیرات به استواستات در طی روند بهبودی با انسولین (Conversion of Beta-Hydroxybutyrate to Acetoacetate)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «اکسیداسیون و تبدیل هورمونی بتا-هیدروکسی‌بوتیرات به استواستات در طی روند بهبودی با انسولین (Conversion of Beta-Hydroxybutyrate to Acetoacetate)» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.
questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.question_en: A 15-year-old boy with a history of frequent seizures since childhood was referred. Calcification of the basal ganglia has been observed in the CT scan of the brain. (Ca=6(8-10), P=6(5-2.5 and Cr=1) which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
options_fa: اختلال مادرزادی در فعال‌شدن آنزیمی ویتامین D

questions.question_en: A 30-year-old woman was brought to the emergency room with a reduced level of consciousness, a blood sample was taken from the patient, and intravenous sugar was immediately injected, and the patient became fully conscious. The result of the blood sugar test at the patient's arrival is 30 mg/dL, and in the same sample, high insulin and low C-peptides were reported. Which case is more likely in the differential diagnosis of hypoglycemia?
options_fa: تومور مترشحه انسولین غده پانکراس (انسولینوما)

questions.explanation_fa:

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «تزریق پنهانی یا تصادفی داروی انسولین خارجی اگزوژن (Exogenous Insulin)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «تزریق پنهانی یا تصادفی داروی انسولین خارجی اگزوژن (Exogenous Insulin)» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.
questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

HbA1c: 6.8%. What is the most likely diagnosis?

بیماری دیابت قندی نوع ۲ (Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus)
صرفاً اختلال تست تحمل گلوکز (Impaired Glucose Tolerance - IGT)

questions.question_en: What is the sign of a positive Pemberton's sign in thyroid examination?

questions.explanation_fa:
تحلیل بالینی و صورت مسئله: در این سناریو، بیمار با تظاهرات «در معاینه فیزیکی گردن و تیروئید بیماری با گواتر بزرگ، پزشک از بیمار می‌خواهد هر دو دست خود را به طور کامل بالای سر برده و به گوش‌های خود بچسباند؛ پس از ۶۰ ثانیه، احتقان وریدی، سیانوز و برافروختگی شدید صورت و پلتورا پدیدار شده و دیس‌پنه تنفسی ایجاد می‌شود (علامت مثبت پمبرتون / Pemberton's Sign). این علامت نشانه چیست؟» در حیطه تخصصی غدد تحت ارزیابی قرار گرفته است. با استناد به مبانی تشخیصی و تصمیم‌گیری بالینی مرجع کانونی اصول طب داخلی هاریسون (ویرایش ۲۲)، بخش غدد درون‌ریز، متابولیسم و دیابت، اقدام انتخابی و پاسخ صحیح بالینی «گواتر بزرگ با گسترش به پشت جناغ سینه (گواتر رترواسترنال / Retrosternal Goiter)» می‌باشد.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «گواتر بزرگ با گسترش به پشت جناغ سینه (گواتر رترواسترنال / Retrosternal Goiter)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «گواتر بزرگ با گسترش به پشت جناغ سینه (گواتر رترواسترنال / Retrosternal Goiter)» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.
questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

تحلیل بالینی و صورت مسئله: در این سناریو، بیمار با تظاهرات «خانم ۵۱ ساله‌ای با ندول منفرد به ابعاد ۳×۲ سانتی‌متر در لوب راست تیروئید مراجعه کرده است؛ در آزمایشات بیوشیمیایی تیروئید سطح TSH کمتر از ۰٫۱ mIU/L (سرکوب‌شده) است؛ در گزارش پاتولوژی اولین بیوپسی با سوزن ظریف ندول، نتیجه به عنوان «نمونه ناکافی و فاقد سلولار بیوپسی (Non-diagnostic / Bethesda Category I)» گزارش شده است. اقدام بالینی استاندارد بعدی چیست؟» در حیطه تخصصی غدد تحت ارزیابی قرار گرفته است. با استناد به مبانی تشخیصی و تصمیم‌گیری بالینی مرجع کانونی اصول طب داخلی هاریسون (ویرایش ۲۲)، بخش غدد درون‌ریز، متابولیسم و دیابت، اقدام انتخابی و پاسخ صحیح بالینی «تکرار مجدد بیوپسی FNA تحت گاید دقیق اولتراسونوگرافی (Repeat US-Guided FNA)» می‌باشد.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

In the investigation, the patient's insulin was stopped two days ago. Laboratory findings: BS: 340mg/dl, K: 4.2meq/L, PH: 7.1, U/A: Ketone=+++, HCO3: 10meq/L. Which action is correct at the beginning of treatment?

تجویز همزمان هیدراتاسیون با سرم نرمال سالین همراه با شروع انسولین رگولار وریدی (Normal Saline + Regular Insulin)

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «تجویز همزمان هیدراتاسیون با سرم نرمال سالین همراه با شروع انسولین رگولار وریدی (Normal Saline + Regular Insulin)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «تجویز همزمان هیدراتاسیون با سرم نرمال سالین همراه با شروع انسولین رگولار وریدی (Normal Saline + Regular Insulin)» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.
questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Calcium interpretation is done with albumin or ionized calcium. In increasing calcium, PTH is the first differential branch; High PTH goes to hyperparathyroidism and low PTH goes to malignancy/vitamin D and other causes. Osteoporosis is diagnosed by fragility fracture or T-score and treated with adequate calcium/vitamin D, exercise, and antiresorptive or bone-forming drugs. CKD-MBD requires simultaneous interpretation of calcium, phosphorus, PTH and vitamin D.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_fa:
تحلیل بالینی و صورت مسئله: در این سناریو، بیمار با تظاهرات «خانم ۲۵ ساله‌ای از طرف متخصص پوست جهت مشاوره غدد ارجاع شده است؛ در معاینه در سطح قدامی ساق هر دو پا پلاک‌های بنفش‌رنگ تیره، سفت، بدون گوده با حدود مشخص، بدون درد و با نمای ضخیم «پوست پرتقالی» (Peau d'orange) دارد؛ بیمار می‌گوید ضایعات پس از تروما تشدید می‌شوند (میکس‌ادم پره‌تیبیال / Pretibial Myxedema). کدام بررسی بیشترین کمک را به تأیید ماهیت اختصاصی تیروئیدی این درموپاتی می‌کند؟» در حیطه تخصصی غدد تحت ارزیابی قرار گرفته است. با استناد به مبانی تشخیصی و تصمیم‌گیری بالینی مرجع کانونی اصول طب داخلی هاریسون (ویرایش ۲۲)، بخش غدد درون‌ریز، متابولیسم و دیابت، اقدام انتخابی و پاسخ صحیح بالینی «بررسی وجود علائم افتالموپاتی و درگیری چشمی تیروئید (Check for Thyroid Ophthalmopathy)» می‌باشد.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «بررسی وجود علائم افتالموپاتی و درگیری چشمی تیروئید (Check for Thyroid Ophthalmopathy)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «بررسی وجود علائم افتالموپاتی و درگیری چشمی تیروئید (Check for Thyroid Ophthalmopathy)» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.
questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.question_en: A 62-year-old woman came to the hospital three days ago due to acute back pain, following a severe cough. He has no history of trauma. He has been complaining of muscle weakness and constipation since 4 months ago. In the examination, there is sensitivity on the back vertebrae with kyphosis. In tests: WBC=6000, Hb=13, plt=200000, ESR=22, Cr=1.5, Ca=12, Ph=2.6, Alkp=200 (>306) serum proteins electrophoresis is normal. What is the most likely diagnosis?

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.explanation_en: Primary adrenal insufficiency is suggested by hypotension, hyponatremia, increased potassium, and pallor of the skin and is confirmed by morning cortisol/ACTH and provocation test. Adrenal crisis requires immediate intravenous hydrocortisone and serum. Cushing's is diagnosed with cortisol excess and standard screening tests; Once proven, ACTH directs the cause. Pheochromocytoma is diagnosed with metanephrines and treated with alpha block before beta block.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.explanation_en: Calcium interpretation is done with albumin or ionized calcium. In increasing calcium, PTH is the first differential branch; High PTH goes to hyperparathyroidism and low PTH goes to malignancy/vitamin D and other causes. Osteoporosis is diagnosed by fragility fracture or T-score and treated with adequate calcium/vitamin D, exercise, and antiresorptive or bone-forming drugs. CKD-MBD requires simultaneous interpretation of calcium, phosphorus, PTH and vitamin D.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «شروع درمان دارویی با قرص متفورمین همراه با اصلاح سبک زندگی و ورزش (Metformin + Diet & Exercise)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «بیماری کم‌کاری آشکار و اولیه تیروئید (Primary Overt Hypothyroidism)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Primary adrenal insufficiency is suggested by hypotension, hyponatremia, increased potassium, and pallor of the skin and is confirmed by morning cortisol/ACTH and provocation test. Adrenal crisis requires immediate intravenous hydrocortisone and serum. Cushing's is diagnosed with cortisol excess and standard screening tests; Once proven, ACTH directs the cause. Pheochromocytoma is diagnosed with metanephrines and treated with alpha block before beta block.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

تحلیل بالینی و صورت مسئله: در این سناریو، بیمار با تظاهرات «خانم ۴۲ ساله‌ای با شکایت از دردهای استخوانی منتشر و ضعف عضلانی مراجعه کرده است؛ در اولتراسونوگرافی کلیه‌ها، سنگ‌های کلسیمی متعدد دوطرفه در سیستم پیلوکالیس مشهود است؛ در آزمایشات بیوشیمیایی: کلسیم تام سرم Ca=11.6 mg/dL (هایپرکلسمی)، فسفر سرم P=2.2 mg/dL (پایین) و سطح هورمون intact PTH=95 pg/mL (افزایش نامتناسب) گزارش شده است. محتمل‌ترین تشخیص بالینی قطعی کدام است؟» در حیطه تخصصی غدد تحت ارزیابی قرار گرفته است. با استناد به مبانی تشخیصی و تصمیم‌گیری بالینی مرجع کانونی اصول طب داخلی هاریسون (ویرایش ۲۲)، بخش غدد درون‌ریز، متابولیسم و دیابت، اقدام انتخابی و پاسخ صحیح بالینی «بیماری هایپرپاراتیروئیدیسم اولیه (Primary Hyperparathyroidism)» می‌باشد.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «بیماری هایپرپاراتیروئیدیسم اولیه (Primary Hyperparathyroidism)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

questions.explanation_en: Calcium interpretation is done with albumin or ionized calcium. In increasing calcium, PTH is the first differential branch; High PTH goes to hyperparathyroidism and low PTH goes to malignancy/vitamin D and other causes. Osteoporosis is diagnosed by fragility fracture or T-score and treated with adequate calcium/vitamin D, exercise, and antiresorptive or bone-forming drugs. CKD-MBD requires simultaneous interpretation of calcium, phosphorus, PTH and vitamin D.

questions.explanation_en: Pituitary disease is investigated with target hormone and trophic hormone pattern, pressure symptoms and MRI. High prolactin should be separated from pregnancy, medication, hypothyroidism and stalk effect; Macroprolactinoma is usually treated with a dopamine agonist. Acromegaly is confirmed by IGF-1 screening and post-sugar test/MRI. In multiaxial hypothyroidism, glucocorticoid is given before thyroid hormone.

questions.explanation_fa:

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_fa:
تحلیل بالینی و صورت مسئله: در این سناریو، بیمار با تظاهرات «در مطالعات اپیدمیولوژیک و ارزیابی ریسک‌فاکتورهای بالینی پیشرفت آسیب اعصاب محیطی در بیماران مبتلا به دیابت قندی، تمام موارد زیر از عوامل خطر اثبات‌شده برای بروز و تشدید «نوروپاتی دیابتی» محسوب می‌شوند، بجز:» در حیطه تخصصی غدد تحت ارزیابی قرار گرفته است. با استناد به مبانی تشخیصی و تصمیم‌گیری بالینی مرجع کانونی اصول طب داخلی هاریسون (ویرایش ۲۲)، بخش غدد درون‌ریز، متابولیسم و دیابت، اقدام انتخابی و پاسخ صحیح بالینی «بالا بودن ایزوله میزان کلسترول تام خون (Isolated High Total Cholesterol)» می‌باشد.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «بالا بودن ایزوله میزان کلسترول تام خون (Isolated High Total Cholesterol)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «شروع درمان دارویی با لووتیروکسین و بررسی مجدد سطح پرولاکتین ۲ ماه بعد (Levothyroxine First)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «سطح کلسترول لیپوپروتئین با دانسیته پایین بالاتر از ۱۰۰ میلی‌گرم در دسی‌لیتر (LDL > 100 mg/dL)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

شروع سرم نرمال سالین همراه با انفوزیون انسولین رگولار

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Calcium interpretation is done with albumin or ionized calcium. In increasing calcium, PTH is the first differential branch; High PTH goes to hyperparathyroidism and low PTH goes to malignancy/vitamin D and other causes. Osteoporosis is diagnosed by fragility fracture or T-score and treated with adequate calcium/vitamin D, exercise, and antiresorptive or bone-forming drugs. CKD-MBD requires simultaneous interpretation of calcium, phosphorus, PTH and vitamin D.

questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «تأکید قاطع بر مصرف منظم انسولین به عنوان تنها درمان قطعی و حیات‌بخش (Insulin is the Sole Life-Saving Therapy)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «تأکید قاطع بر مصرف منظم انسولین به عنوان تنها درمان قطعی و حیات‌بخش (Insulin is the Sole Life-Saving Therapy)» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.
questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

options_fa: اعمال محدودیت شدید مصرف پروتئین‌های رژیم غذایی (Severe Dietary Protein Restriction)
درمان دارویی با مهارکننده‌های آنزیم مبدل آنژیوتانسین (ACE Inhibitors)
کنترل فشرده گلوکز خون در محدوده هدف نرمال (HbA1c < 7%)

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «سطح ایزوله کلسترول بد لیپوپروتئین با دانسیته پایین معادل ۱۸۰ میلی‌گرم در دسی‌لیتر (Isolated LDL=180 mg/dL)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «سطح ایزوله کلسترول بد لیپوپروتئین با دانسیته پایین معادل ۱۸۰ میلی‌گرم در دسی‌لیتر (Isolated LDL=180 mg/dL)» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.
questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.explanation_en: Primary adrenal insufficiency is suggested by hypotension, hyponatremia, increased potassium, and pallor of the skin and is confirmed by morning cortisol/ACTH and provocation test. Adrenal crisis requires immediate intravenous hydrocortisone and serum. Cushing's is diagnosed with cortisol excess and standard screening tests; Once proven, ACTH directs the cause. Pheochromocytoma is diagnosed with metanephrines and treated with alpha block before beta block.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «۲۹۸ میلی‌گرم در دسی‌لیتر (298 mg/dL)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. questions.explanation_en: Thyroid evaluation begins with TSH and is completed with free T4. A low TSH in a thyroid nodule prompts a functional scan first, and a normal/high TSH opens the way for ultrasound and sampling. Primary hypothyroidism has high TSH and low T4; Levothyroxine treatment is with a dose appropriate for age and heart. Hyperthyroidism is managed with symptomatic beta blockers and antithyroid/iodine/surgery based on the cause. In pregnancy, the goals and drugs are specific.

questions.explanation_en: Lipid therapy is based on total heart risk and LDL; First-line statin and its intensity determined by ASCVD, diabetes and risk. Very high triglycerides are a risk factor for pancreatitis and require reduced dietary fat, diabetes control, and selective fibrate/omega-3. Obesity is a chronic disease and is treated with nutrition, activity, behavioral therapy, weight-effective drugs, and metabolic surgery based on BMI and comorbidity. Secondary causes and medications should be reviewed.

questions.explanation_en: Diabetes is diagnosed by fasting glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, or glucose tolerance test based on standard thresholds, and repeat confirmation is usually necessary in an asymptomatic individual. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, metformin in the appropriate individual, and early selection of an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 agonist based on heart disease, kidney disease, weight, and risk of hypoglycemia. Screening for albuminuria, retinopathy, neuropathy and cardiac risk factors is essential. In ketoacidosis, fluid, insulin, potassium and stimulant therapy are performed in physiological order.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «انجام اسکن رادیوایزوتوپ تیروئید با ید یا تکنسیم (Radioiodine/Technetium Thyroid Scan)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.
